detail.requirements:
• 5+ years of experience in technology architecture, designing and implementing scalable, resilient systems.
• Ability to align IT and business priorities to deliver impactful solutions. Ability to shape long-term solution strategies and influence architectural roadmaps.
• Expertise in defining project scope, managing client-serving contexts, and driving successful implementations.
• Experience mentoring and guiding technical teams to deliver high-quality solutions.
• Strong understanding of architectural design principles for cloud-native and hybrid solutions with hands-on experience with at least one major public cloud platform (AWS, Azure, or GCP).
• Expertise in modern deployment and infrastructure technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes, SecDevOps).
• Proficiency in programming languages (e.g., Python, Node.js) and frameworks (e.g., Express, React).
• Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code tools (e.g., Pulumi, Terraform) and CI/CD pipelines.
• Experience with DevOps methodologies and Agile development practices.
• Experience conducting technical feasibility assessments for large-scale projects, evaluating risks, tradeoffs, and benefits.
• Strong communication skills to engage technical and non-technical stakeholders, including C-level executives.
• Fluent language skills in both Korean and English to collaborate with local and global teams.
detail.main_tasks:
• You will play a pivotal role in shaping the strategy, architecture, design, and implementation of technology initiatives across AWS, Azure, and GCP.
• Your expertise across industries will be highly valued as you deliver innovative, scalable, and resilient solutions for our clients.
• Defining and implementing strategies for cloud-native and hybrid solutions tailored to meet the unique needs of clients across industries.
• Re-architecting legacy systems to optimize performance, scalability, and efficiency in cloud environments.
• Guiding clients through large-scale digital transformations, working with C-level executives to align IT and business priorities.
• Designing and implementing secure, efficient, and scalable cloud networking and connectivity solutions for hybrid and multi-cloud environments.
• Leading teams in the technical implementation and integration of on-premises, hybrid, and cloud platforms (SaaS, PaaS, IaaS), ensuring scalable, reliable, and cost-efficient solutions.
• Working with diverse teams, including data scientists, engineers, designers, and business strategists, to deliver impactful, technology-enabled solutions.
• Your work will transform businesses and position you as a trusted advisor, helping clients navigate complex technical challenges and achieve their strategic goals.
detail.intro: Driving lasting impact and building long-term capabilities with our clients is not easy work. You are the kind of person who thrives in a high performance/high reward culture - doing hard things, picking yourself up when you stumble, and having the resilience to try another way forward. In return for your drive, determination, and curiosity, we'll provide the resources, mentorship, and opportunities you need to become a stronger leader faster than you ever thought possible.
detail.benefits:
• Continuous learning: Our learning and apprenticeship culture, backed by structured programs, is all about helping you grow while creating an environment where feedback is clear, actionable, and focused on your development.
• A voice that matters: From day one, we value your ideas and contributions.
• Global community: With colleagues across 65+ countries and over 100 different nationalities, our firm's diversity fuels creativity and helps us come up with the best solutions for our clients.
• World-class benefits: On top of a competitive salary (based on your location, experience, and skills), we provide a comprehensive benefits package to enable holistic well-being for you and your family.
detail.preferred_points: • FIG (Financial Institutions Group) experience is a plus, not mandatory.
